---
params:
  x:
  title:
  dbh_scale:
title: "\\fontsize{12}{14}\\selectfont Stichprobenpunkt `r params$title`"
classoption:
  - twocolumn
  - a4paper
geometry:
  - landscape
  - margin=1in
fontsize: 11pt
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

x <- params$x

# Filter dead/removal trees
if ("removal" %in% names(x$trees)) {
  live_ids <- x$trees$tree_id[!x$trees$removal]
  x$trees         <- x$trees[!x$trees$removal, , drop = FALSE]
  x$tree_positions <- x$tree_positions[
    x$tree_positions$tree_id %in% live_ids, , drop = FALSE]
}
```

\vspace*{\fill}

```{r table}
oo <- options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

tp <- x$tree_positions |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::select(tree_id, R, angle) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    x$trees |>
      dplyr::select(tree_id, species_id, dbh_cm, age_yr, height_m)
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Nr. = tree_id, Baumart = species_id, BHD = dbh_cm, Winkel = angle,
    Entfernung = R, Alter = age_yr, Höhe = height_m
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Baumart = stringr::word(format(Baumart, spec_lang = "ger"), 1))

knitr::kable(tp, "latex")

options(oo)
```

\vspace*{\fill}

\newpage

\vspace*{\fill}

```{r plot, results = "asis"}
oo <- options(fe_spec_lang = "ger")
plotting_set <- merge(x$tree_positions, x$trees)
x_plot <- plot(x, dbh_scale = params$dbh_scale, show_labels = FALSE)
final_plot <- x_plot +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.x    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 315),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = paste0(.data$tree_id, ": ",
                     stringr::str_sub(format(.data$species_id),
                                      start = 1, end = 2))
    ),
    nudge_x = 1.8, nudge_y = 0.1, size = 2.5, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = .data$dbh_cm
    ),
    nudge_x = 1., nudge_y = -0.60, size = 2, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = .data$R
    ),
    nudge_x = 1., nudge_y = -1.20, size = 2, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = plotting_set,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 1],
      y = sf::st_coordinates(.data$geometry)[, 2],
      label = .data$angle
    ),
    nudge_x = 1., nudge_y = -1.70, size = 2, force = 2.0,
    segment.size = 0, arrow = NULL
  )

fig_file <- normalizePath(tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
ggplot2::ggsave(fig_file, plot = final_plot, width = 4.5, height = 4.5, device = "pdf")
cat(sprintf("\\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth]{%s}\n\\vspace*{\\fill}\n", fig_file))
options(oo)
```
